§6Uranium Hexafluoride§f

§aTurn yellowcake into gas, then centrifuge it into something useful. The enrichment pipeline.§f

UF6 is a corrosive radioactive gas and the final step before uranium enrichment. Must be processed in a §bGas Centrifuge§f to separate U-235 from U-238.

Production (Chemical Plant, 5s, 500HE/t): §e1,000mB§f Water + Yellowcake + §e4§f Fluorite = §e1,200mB§f UF6 + §e2§f Sulfur.

Storage requires a specialized tank or Fluid Barrels. Processing via Gas Centrifuge separates the majority U-238 from the small amount of U-235. The SILEX can also process it.

Other use: Pulsating Crystal (crafted using UF6 in cells).

§cWARNING:§f UF6 is both corrosive and radioactive. Full PPE required.

§ePS:§f One batch of §e1,200mB§f UF6 feeds a full centrifuge cascade. Scale up Yellowcake production before starting enrichment.
